thread:
Mira: Proposal for a focused pilot: 'Recommendation Orchestration' — a lightweight Optimize assistant that surface batching/caching/quant recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Goal: validate impact on cost and quality for customer teams. Pilot scope below, please react with gaps.

Jason: :eyes: skimmed — looks good. Quick q: are we doing on-hosted API first or Dedicated?

Mira: Hosted API only for pilot. We want to avoid infra churn. Dedicated/private follow-up if customers ask.

Anya: For the quant recommendations we need a small eval harness per customer. Must collect per-model perplexity/acceptability on a ~1k prompt set. Will that be ok?

Mira: Yes — acceptance criteria requires no more than 3% drop in our eval score vs baseline at target speedups.

Sam: SRE note: pilot SLA targets need to be explicit. I'm worried about continuous batching adding latency spikes. Can we set p95/p99 SLOs?

Mira: Good call. SLOs: p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 500ms for interactive routes. Non-interactive (bulk batch) targets are different.

Oliver: DevEx ask: API contract must remain stable. If we return recommendations as a separate endpoint, clients can opt-in. Prefer: POST /optimize/recs with param {route, workload_profile}.

Jason: Implementation note: we should expose confidence score + suggested config and estimated cost delta. Minimal schema: {suggestion: string, estimated_cost_delta: number, confidence: 0-1}.

Anya: Eval-triggered alerts — propose thresholds: regression >1.5% on moving eval baseline for 24h -> alert product/ML. Also fatal regressions >3% immediate page.

Sam: Paging on eval alerts is rough. Can we route to #optimize-alerts first and only page if we see repeated windows? Prefer: notif -> ops channel -> oncall after escalation.

Mira: Agreed. Escalation flow: #optimize-alerts -> oncall-sre after two consecutive windows (6h).

deploy-bot: deploy status: opt-orch service on staging passed canary 3/3, cfg flag `opt_orch_pilot` ready.

Jason: For batching/caching: we need per-tenant KV cache metrics + hit-rate histograms exposed to telemetry. That will let us decide when to recommend cache.

Oliver: UX: make recommendations actionable — copyable JSON + one-click apply (for customers on Dedicated later). For hosted, a config export will do.

Anya: Data/Privacy: recommendations must not include any raw user content. Only model_id, route, stats, and hashed prompt fingerprints. Confirmed?

Mira: Confirmed. No PII leaves the tenant. Also need a customer opt-in checkbox (explicit) during pilot.

Sam: Cost modeling: can we surface estimated token-level savings and projected monthly $ delta? Ops will need that for sign-off.

Jason: I'll add a lightweight estimator (baseline tokens * delta_per_token * price) — rough but useful.

Mira: Pilot acceptance criteria (proposed):
- Run with 5 pilot customers for 6 weeks
- No more than 3% eval quality drop across pilot customers
- Average token-cost reduction >= 12% for routable workloads OR measurable latency improvement (>10% p95)
- Observability: per-tenant hit-rate, cost delta, inference latency dashboards live
- Recommendation API and consent flow in place

Oliver: Launch gates: Legal sign-off on data handling, Security review (threat model + KMS), Product sign-off on UX, SRE capacity ok.

Sam: Do we need a scoped rollback plan? If recommenders cause regressions, we need automatic disable fallback — config flag `opt_orch_enable` + model fallback path.

Mira: Yes — auto-disable on >3% regression for 6h and notify customers. Manual override for product.

Anya: Operational playbook addendum: steps to reproduce alert, rollback command, contacting customer, re-eval flow. I'll draft.

Jason: Timeline suggestion: 2-week build, 4-week pilot, 1-week wrap (metrics + debrief). Total 7 weeks.

Mira: Proposed owners: PM (Mira), Eng lead (Jason), ML (Anya), SRE (Sam), DevEx (Oliver).

Oliver: I'll prep the onboarding checklist + consent flow copy.

Sam: I'll scope the telemetry dashboards and incident playbook.

Anya: I'll prepare per-customer eval harness and baseline datasets.

Mira: Next steps: sync tomorrow 11am PT to lock scope + pick pilot customers. Please drop any missing constraints here. :rocket:
